notes: Versions: APM 760/715/710/700 captured 2018-05-18 (page revisions 2006-2015), APM 133 captured 2017-03-09 (Rev. 9/1/15): read as in force on 2018-02-28. Red Binder VI-4 is read from the October 2017 memo (Rev. 5/17), which supersedes the May 2017 memo's Rev. 5/16 text (same substance). VI-1, VI-5, VI-7 and I-4 are read from the May 2017 memo (version note: not changed again before the reference date). The memo PDFs merge struck and inserted text; the passages used read cleanly.

Birth-parent chain: active service-modified duties (2 quarters) containing the childbearing leave (pregnancy disability leave, up to 4 months; first 6 weeks paid at base salary; FMLA alongside) → parental leave without pay (up to 1 year) with CFRA 12 workweeks alongside, both starting at the end of the childbearing leave; paid medical leave (2 quarters, pay within it) also available in addition to childbearing leave, then discretionary unpaid medical leave; everything capped at one year per birth (leave_limits).
Non-birth-parent chain: active service-modified duties 1 quarter (unlinked); parental leave without pay up to 1 year with FMLA and CFRA concurrent from its start; capped at one year per birth.

Calendar: UCSB is on quarters; Red Binder VI-5 E equates one quarter with 12 weeks, coded term_weeks 12 (R8). If that sentence is read as an ASMD length rather than a term length, the R8 quarter default (11) would apply instead.

The saved statute texts are 2026 captures (FMLA 29 USC 2611-2612; Cal. Gov. Code 12945 and 12945.2); the lengths used (12 workweeks, four months) and the CFRA-in-addition-to-PDL clause are as in the policy texts of 2018; statute_verified set on that basis.

Not components: continued health-plan coverage during FML (benefit continuation, not leave); reinstatement rights (part of c1/c3/c15); personnel-review deferral and 'not arbitrarily disadvantaged' protection (APM 760-31; no time off); sabbatical-credit effects; APM 711 reasonable accommodation for disabilities (disability accommodation, not pregnancy-specific); leave to attend meetings, educational leave, special research (fellowship) leave (Red Binder VI-7 A, E, F; not usable for a birth); significant-circumstance tenure-clock extension (I-4 II.c, APM 133-17-h(3); events beyond control such as natural disasters, not usable for a birth).
Health Sciences Compensation Plan paid medical leave is in school procedures not saved (APM 710-11); UCSB has no HSCP school, recorded only for c21.

Red Binder VI-4 D says Senate members 'will be covered by B) above, regardless of length of service'; B is pay from sick or vacation balances, which Senate faculty do not accrue (APM 710-0-a). Read with APM 760-25-b(2) as full pay for up to 6 weeks regardless of service (c2), flagged.
